title: Infrastructure Stability Measurement Protocol
description: Field-deployable metrics for tracking system state. Prioritizes physical and behavioral signals over financial proxies. Addresses management signal lag (tau) by establishing short-latency physical reporting pathways.

measurement_philosophy.core_problem: Financial metrics are a high-pass filter on physical system state. Slow degradation — exactly what precedes nonlinear failure — is invisible until acute. tau_management_lag is not random noise; it is structural.
measurement_philosophy.solution: Establish parallel physical measurement pipeline with direct routing to decision layer. Bypass middle-layer aggregation that strips degradation signal.

signal_hierarchy.tier_1_physical: Direct energy, material, labor flow measurements. Fastest time constant. Most accurate.
signal_hierarchy.tier_2_behavioral: Field-observable behaviors: hazard detection rates, anomaly reporting, labor flow patterns.
signal_hierarchy.topological_blind_spot: The tier hierarchy orders metrics by latency and filtering, and Phi sits at the top of it. Ledger F-002 and F-003 established that Phi does not see the damage done by wrong-order activation at all: aggregate labor improved while hub survival fell to 30pct and inter-community connectivity to 44pct. Scalar aggregates average over the network structure that carries the cascade. The two topological metrics on the early warning dashboard exist because no amount of improvement in tier-1 scalar measurement would have surfaced that failure. The same argument applies to common-mode climate drivers: ENSO moves Em, E and L_f_active adversely in the same phase, so improving the accuracy of each channel separately cannot recover a coupling that lives between them (ledger F-015). And Phi itself cannot distinguish recovery from capability loss, so it must always be reported with its decomposition (ledger F-016).
signal_hierarchy.tier_3_proxy: Financial and administrative metrics. Slowest, most filtered. Do not use as primary stability indicators.

phi_measurement.description: Maintenance burden ratio Phi. Primary stability metric.

latent_recovery_channel.time_constant: 0.5-2 years — leading indicator if measured correctly
latent_recovery_channel.note: Response rate by channel type directly measures outreach_mode effectiveness and signal_fidelity impact. Broadcast channels will show near-zero response in high-R_i target populations.

p_engage_measurement.description: Engagement probability tracking across target populations.

methods.direct: Anonymous survey in target communities — willingness to consider re-engagement given specific structural conditions
methods.behavioral: Response rate and quality by outreach channel
methods.network: Referral yield per activated node — measures trust_centrality and cascade_potential

p_engage_measurement.stratification: Stratify by: prior_institutional_rejection_history, cohort_age, domain, geographic_region
p_engage_measurement.warning_signal: If p_engage_mean is not rising within 90 days of outreach launch, diagnose: either B_i is still high in target context, or signal_fidelity is insufficient, or channel is wrong. Do not increase outreach volume — diagnose and fix.

R_i_measurement.description: Hazard recognition capacity. Cannot be measured by credential review. Requires behavioral observation.

simulation_exercise.description: Controlled scenario with embedded hazard signals at varying salience levels
simulation_exercise.administration: Must be administered by field-credible practitioners, not HR or testing services

incident_record_review.description: Review near-miss reports and anomaly flagging history

peer_nomination.description: Sociometric: who do coworkers consult in hazard situations?

propagation_tracking.description: Measure R_i transfer from mentor to mentee nodes over time
propagation_tracking.expected_pattern: sigmoid: slow initial transfer, accelerating through mid-ramp, plateauing near mentor R_i level

B_i_measurement.description: Signal obstruction factor. Requires anonymous or indirect measurement — direct survey in high-B_i contexts produces false negatives.
B_i_measurement.warning_signal: If high_peer_rated_competence nodes are turning over at elevated rates, B_i is high and suppressing them. Investigate credit_capture and incentive_misalignment before launching activation campaigns.

kappa_measurement.description: Coupling coefficient proxy. Measures cascade potential.

early_warning_dashboard.description: Minimum viable monitoring set for decision-layer signal pipeline. Short tau target: 30-day lag maximum from field to decision.

metrics.warning_threshold: Nino3.4 anomaly above +0.5C with a coupled atmospheric response, or any official El Nino advisory
metrics.alarm_threshold: Nino3.4 anomaly above +2.0C, or a second event arriving within 3 years of the previous one
metrics.rationale: Ledger F-015. ENSO is the only common-mode driver in this protocol with a usable forecast lead. It moves Em, E and L_f_active adversely in the same phase, so it is the one early-warning signal that predicts simultaneous movement in all three terms of Phi rather than in one.
metrics.measurement_note: Tier 1 because it is a direct physical observation with short reporting latency, not because the model has calibrated its effect. Lead time is the point: it is the only entry on this dashboard that gives months of warning rather than reporting a change after it happened. Treat the lead as shrinking for Central Pacific events, which become both more common and less predictable under warming.

metrics.warning_threshold: Phi falling while C is also falling — the burden ratio improving through capability loss
metrics.alarm_threshold: C falling and L_f_active falling in the same reporting period, regardless of what Phi does
metrics.rationale: Ledger F-016. Phi is a ratio and cannot distinguish recovery from managed collapse. Under sustained stress the simulated system sheds complexity it can no longer maintain, and Phi improves because the numerator shrank. Reporting Phi alone shows that as success.
metrics.measurement_note: Report Em, E, L_f_active and C as four separate series alongside Phi. A dashboard that plots Phi as a single line is not implementing this protocol. The direction of C is what separates the two ways Phi can fall.

metrics.warning_threshold: any locality where maintenance demand, primary energy supply and outdoor labor availability share a dominant climate driver
metrics.alarm_threshold: that locality also carries a high-kappa interface
metrics.rationale: Ledger F-015. The point of a common-mode audit is to find the places where the three terms of Phi are not independent. Independent channel estimates cannot recover this, however accurate each one is.
metrics.measurement_note: Assess per locality and never as a system mean. Global aggregates cancel this signal: hydropower production anomalies are individually significant at more than a third of dams and sum to a weak, statistically insignificant net global anomaly. A system average of ENSO exposure reads as approximately zero while the regions carrying the infrastructure are individually stressed.

metrics.rationale: Ledger F-003. Wrong-order activation is hub-destroying, not intervention-destroying: hub survival fell from 100pct to 30pct while aggregate labor still improved over no intervention. Phi cannot see this and neither can a headcount. Identify the top decile by peer nomination (see R_i_measurement.field_methods.peer_nomination), not by title or credential, and track them by name.

Ledger F-003. Bridge-node survival fell to 22pct and inter-community edges alive to 44pct under wrong-order activation, while all communities were still reached. The network stays connected enough to function and becomes too fragmented to propagate again. Referrals that cross crew, site, or community boundaries are the observable proxy for the edges that were lost.
metrics.measurement_note: Count referrals whose source and target are in different crews, sites, or communities, as a fraction of all referrals. The absolute rate matters less than the trend against the pre-campaign baseline, so the baseline must be taken before outreach begins, not after.

field_to_decision_pipeline.description: Physical field metrics must route directly to decision layer without middle-layer aggregation that strips degradation signal.

reporting_structure.false_negative_prevention: Physical metrics and financial metrics must be compared explicitly. Divergence between physical degradation signals and positive financial indicators is itself a warning signal — it indicates tau is large and correction will be late.
